name: Matthew Quinn
sources: Obituary of John J. Quinn Jr., Baltimore Sun, 19 May 2013 (Legacy.com)
Barbara McKeldin Adams, "Barbara McKeldin Adams - A Memoir" (privately printed)
notes: A first cousin of Barbara McKeldin Adams through her stepmother Peggy (Quinn) McKeldin; Barbara names the cousins Quinn, Tommy, Mark, Tim, Michael, Sharon, John, Joanie, Matthew, Billy and Bobbie. [Barbara McKeldin Adams, A Memoir, text line 413]
Of Forest Hill, Maryland. A Billy Joel fan; his cousins took him to Billy Joel's concerts. [Barbara McKeldin Adams, A Memoir, text line 3015]
